status.onHoldHint: Your time starts on your first connection.
status.limitedHint: Renew your subscription to connect again.
status.expiredHint: Until you renew, the connection won't work.
status.disabledHint: The connection won't work for now. Support will tell you why and how to turn it back on.
status.lowDataHint: Your data is running low. Renew before it runs out.
status.lowTimeHint: Your subscription ends soon. Renew before it ends.
status.lowBothHint: Your data and time are running low. Renew before they run out.
status.leftoverNote: Leftover time and data can't be used until you renew. Ask support what happens to them after renewal.
status.leftoverNoteDisabled: Leftover time and data can't be used until the subscription is turned back on.
status.leftover_time: Your leftover time doesn't carry over to the new purchase.
status.leftover_data: Your leftover data is added to your new purchase after renewing; until then it can't be used.
status.leftover_both: Your leftover data is added to your new purchase after renewing; your leftover time doesn't carry over.
status.leftoverDisabled_time: Your leftover time can't be used until the subscription is turned back on.
status.leftoverDisabled_data: Your leftover data can't be used until the subscription is turned back on.
status.leftoverDisabled_both: Your leftover time and data can't be used until the subscription is turned back on.
status.noReAdd: After renewing, this same subscription connects again; no need to add it again.

status.lowSubData: {{conn}}. Renew when the data runs out, or now if you need more data.
status.lowLead: {{conn}}. Renew before it ends so you stay connected.

connect.title: Connect
connect.stepInstall: If you don't have {{app}} yet, download and install it.
connect.stepPaste: In {{app}}, tap + and choose "Import from clipboard".
connect.stepInstallAny: Install a VPN app from the list below.
connect.stepPasteAny: In the app, tap + and choose "Import from clipboard".
connect.nextAfterCopy: Now open {{app}} and add it as a subscription.
connect.nextAfterCopyAny: Now open your VPN app and add it as a subscription.
connect.endedNote: This subscription won't connect until it's renewed. If you've already added it to an app, you won't need to add it again after renewing.
connect.workingNote: This subscription was used in the last few minutes, so your connection is working.
connect.afterImport: If {{app}} opened, turn the connection on there. Didn't open? Install {{app}} first, or copy the link from "Other ways" and add it by hand.
connect.disabledNote: This subscription is turned off, so it won't connect for now. Contact support to find out why.
connect.step1Skip: You connect with the {{app}} app. If you already have it, skip this step.
connect.idleNote: You haven't used this subscription for a while. If it won't connect, see the connection steps again.
connect.stepPaste_ios: In {{app}}, tap + and choose add from clipboard.
connect.stepPasteAny_ios: In the app, tap + and choose add from clipboard.
connect.stepPaste_desktop: In {{app}}, open "add subscription" (or new profile), paste the link with Ctrl+V and save.
connect.stepPasteAny_desktop: In the app, open "add subscription" (or new profile), paste the link with Ctrl+V and save.
connect.stepPaste_mac: In {{app}}, open "add subscription" (or new profile), paste the link with Cmd+V and save.
connect.stepPasteAny_mac: In the app, open "add subscription" (or new profile), paste the link with Cmd+V and save.
connect.stepConnect_android: In {{app}}, tap connect and allow the VPN request.
connect.stepConnectAny_android: In the app, tap connect and allow the VPN request.
connect.stepConnect_ios: In {{app}}, turn the connection on and allow adding the VPN configuration.
connect.stepConnectAny_ios: In the app, turn the connection on and allow adding the VPN configuration.
connect.stepConnect_desktop: In {{app}}, pick a server and turn the connection (or "system proxy") on.
connect.stepConnectAny_desktop: In the app, pick a server and turn the connection (or "system proxy") on.
connect.stepConnect_mac: In {{app}}, pick a server and turn the connection on; allow it if macOS asks.
connect.stepConnectAny_mac: In the app, pick a server and turn the connection on; allow it if macOS asks.
